column1: # Final Fight VOICED cutscene cues -- the pack side of the contract with the
# ffightcd Sega CD cutscene backport (the Final Fight CD backport project's audio contract is
# the full contract; this file is the machine-readable row set).
# Stock ffight/ffightu/ffightj ROMs NEVER emit these bytes (phase-0 census:
# music/SFX cues top out at 0x58, control family is 0xf0-0xf9), so one pack
# serves both ROM families: stock ROMs hit the no-voice rows (0x35/0x54),
# backport ROMs emit 0x70-0x73 for the voiced Sega-CD cutscene audio:
# 0x70/0x72 at the opening engine's INIT (credit-gated), 0x71/0x73 at the
# ending engine's INIT (not gated).  The ending key MUST be emitted: the stock
# ending-music cue 0x54 fires regardless and maps to the arranged instrumental
# ending, so an un-emitted voiced key leaves the instrumental in its place.
# The stock 0x54 sites emit alias 0x78, gated in the trigger map (row 0x78)
# like 0x74-0x77.
# All four rows: verb=play, suppress=1, gain 0x7f, ONE-SHOT (no loop -- the
# cutscene spans the audio; playback ends itself in the master's own fade).
# Sources are raw CD-DA disc tracks, cut at the cue's INDEX 01 and never
# modified.  The builder extracts them from user-supplied disc rips
# (--us-disc/--jp-disc; pack/discsrc.py + tools/extract_cdda.py) into the
# cd_full / cd_jp_full extraction caches.
# Identity evidence (NCC vs the backport's aligned references):
#   0x72: aligned JP opening = raw tr23 at +0.38s, r=+1.000 piecewise
#   0x73: aligned JP ending  = raw tr24 + 87612-sample lead pad, r=+1.000
#         piecewise at the exact lag.  tr24 holds sample-exact internal
#         repeats (58.013s material recurs at 83.034s, 25.02s period) and
#         tr29 shares one section verbatim -- both earlier double-matches
#         are properties of the master, not assembly.
# Both ENDING rows require PROCESSING before
# packing -- the shipped ROMs are fitted to processed tracks, not the raw
# rips.  Chain per row (full contract: ffightcd AUDIO_CONTRACT.md section 4):
#   0x71  pad 88,200 samples of silence (150 sectors, 2.000000 s), then cut
#         7 bars @ 82.19 BPM at 39.225 s, 0.12 s crossfade.
#   0x73  pad 87,612 samples (149 sectors, 1.986667 s), then cut 8 bars
#         @ 82.19 BPM at 56.0 s, 0.12 s crossfade.
# The processing is build_ffight.py's ARCADE_CUT, PINNED: the builder
# hashes the processed PCM every build (ARCADE_CUT_PIN) against the byte-
# exact files the shipped ROMs were ear-tuned against, verified once against
# the backport project's reference cutter (cut_ending_track.py, byte-
# identical both regions).  A drifted transform refuses to pack.
